title: Rumors of elites having out-of-body experiences in pyramid granite chambers

tellings.quote: have you heard of rumors of sort of elite people you know uh spending time in Granite chamers in some of these pyramids like modern day

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, asks a guest whether he has heard rumours that elite people today spend time inside the granite chambers of some pyramids. The rumour, as the story frames it, is that they go there to have out-of-body experiences, which would mean the chambers still hold some special power that the powerful quietly use.
